Downloads Prebuilt releases are available from **[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/MatrixTM/MHDDoS/releases)**. Each tagged release publishes two archives: - `MHDDoS-.zip` — standalone CLI (`start.py`, config, wordlists, Docker files) - `MHDDoS-web-.zip` — the same runtime plus the `web/` control panel --- ## 🚀 Getting Started ### 📦 Requirements - [Python 3.11 or newer](https://python.org) - [dnspython](https://github.com/rthalley/dnspython) - [cloudscraper](https://github.com/VeNoMouS/cloudscraper) - [impacket](https://github.com/SecureAuthCorp/impacket) - [requests](https://github.com/psf/requests) - [PyRoxy](https://github.com/MatrixTM/PyRoxy) - [icmplib](https://github.com/ValentinBELYN/icmplib) - [certifi](https://github.com/certifi/python-certifi) - [psutil](https://github.com/giampaolo/psutil) - [yarl](https://github.com/aio-libs/yarl) ### 🔧 Clone & Install ```bash git clone https://github.com/MatrixTM/MHDDoS.git cd MHDDoS pip install -r requirements.txt ``` ### ⚡ One-Line Installation on a Fresh VPS ```bash apt -y update && apt -y install curl wget libcurl4 libssl-dev python3 python3-pip make cmake automake autoconf m4 build-essential git && git clone https://github.com/MatrixTM/MHDDoS.git && cd MH* && pip3 install -r requirements.txt ``` --- ## 🐳 Docker ```bash git clone https://github.com/MatrixTM/MHDDoS.git cd MHDDoS docker compose build ``` Then start the container: ```bash docker compose run -it --entrypoint /bin/bash mhddos ``` Or run a method directly: ```bash docker compose run --rm mhddos GET https://example.com 0 100 http.txt 10 60 ``` > [!TIP] > The compose file builds and tags `ghcr.io/matrixtm/mhddos:latest` locally. Replace `build:` with `image:` to use the > published image instead. --- ## 🖥️ Web Panel The repository includes a web control panel. Install its dependencies once: ```bash # Windows (from the repository root) web\scripts\install.bat # Linux / macOS (from the repository root) bash web/scripts/install.sh ``` Then start it from the main CLI: ```bash python start.py WEB ``` The panel listens on `http://127.0.0.1:5000` by default. You can also use the platform launchers directly: `web\scripts\start.bat` on Windows, or `bash web/scripts/start.sh` on Linux/macOS. --- ## 📚 Documentation Full project documentation is available in the **[GitHub Wiki](https://github.com/MatrixTM/MHDDoS/wiki)**. For bug reports and repository-related issues, use **[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/MatrixTM/MHDDoS/issues)**. > [!NOTE] > Please do not use the Issues section for general support questions. --- ## 🌐 Community
